corrections.result: Before execution, the work-unit bound after each transition was raised from 20 to 40. Classification thresholds were unchanged.

The capture driver compared the refusal message as an exact substring and labelled genuine HTTP 400 refusals not_refused, because the service wraps the field name in backticks. The projector derives the preregistered classification from the retained status, the message with backticks removed, and the unchanged retrieved cap.
